english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a talk or artwork's topic, a recurring idea, or an app's selectable visual theme.
Use this for the theme or general subject of a work, event, course, or area of interest, especially in more formal contexts.
Use 主題 as the all-purpose choice when subject means the main topic of a discussion, work, or paper.

examples.english: The theme of this talk is why we need to protect the oceans.
examples.traditional: 呢個演講嘅主題係點解要保護海洋。
